messages:
Evan: Dropped a prototype for role inheritance visualization (tree + heatmap) https://figma.com/file/perm-tree
Priya: Love the idea of a compact tree, but users in research got confused by the heatmap colors. Need a legend and colorblind-safe palette
Hannah: +1 on legend. Also, show explicit inheritance badges like 'inherited from Team X' next to permission chips
Diego: For bulk edits, we should show a clear preview of changes before apply: e.g., 'Grant write on Repo A to 12 users' with a diff view
Kai: Undo is critical. If we apply bulk changes, add a toast with 'Undo' for 30s and an audit entry marked as 'bulk-change' so SRE can investigate
Evan: Microcopy: primary action text currently 'Apply' -> suggest 'Apply changes' to be explicit in bulk flow
Priya: Accessibility: the tree needs keyboard-expandable nodes with role summaries in aria-describedby. Also announce the number of affected principals when expanding
Hannah: Consider a flat table fallback for SR users: the tree is visual-heavy; provide a 'Show as list' toggle that preserves filters and selected node
Diego: Audit linkage: when a user clicks a change in the audit panel, we should highlight the affected node in the tree and open a side detail with before/after values
Kai: For SSO and enforcement toggles in this flow, avoid modal disruptions. Keep toggles inline and surface a confirmation only if removing enforcement
Evan: Performance note: tree expansion for orgs >5k users is slow. We need virtualized rendering and progressive disclosure by default
Priya: Color accessibility: heatmap should have a dual encoding (color + pattern/striping) for users with low color vision
Hannah: Copy nit: role action button named 'Assign role' vs 'Add to role' inconsistent across app. Pick 'Assign role' for clarity with subjects
Diego: Dev ticket for virtualized tree + undo + audit highlight: ENG-13022 assigned to eng-platform
ux-bot: Checklist updated: perm-tree-a11y, bulk-edit-preview, undo-toast, audit-highlight
Evan: Thanks all. Next: Priya to propose palette + legend, Hannah to mock list fallback, Diego to spec diff preview, Kai to add audit schema
